messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: rollout v2.14.1 -> eu-west-1 started 2420001200, canary passed basic health. Running post-release smoke checks now.

mike: noticed a small blip on synth-probes ~2420001250, seeing 429s.

sara: same, our synthetic client shows ~3% 429 rate over a 5m window for embeddings route.

alex: is that on a specific host or across the pool? graphs look spread but concentrated in two AZs.

jen: logs show rate_limiter throttled: "x-rate-limit-retry-after=2" on a subset of hosts, likely hitting burst-per-min config.

mike: sending a quick curl from eu test runner to reproduce:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

mike: got 429 with header `Retry-After: 2` and body {"error":"rate_limited"}

oncall-bot: @mike alerted oncall (sara) — incident ticket INC-3421 created.

sara: looked at redis limiter keys, burst tokens are being consumed quickly by a small number of heavy clients (botnets/ingest jobs).

alex: can we temporarily raise burst to avoid noisy rollback? change window is tight but we can do a config flip on limiter.

jen: we have a safe knob: limiter.burst_eu = 350 -> 450. It’s a config flip via k8s configmap, no pod restart required (hot-reload).

mike: risk = short-term higher token spend, benefit = avoid rollback and user impact. Our SLAs are fine for 30m spike.

sara: running a targeted canary for 10m with the flipped config on 10% of hosts now. Will monitor synth success rate and p95 latency.

deploy-bot: canary patch applied to subset eu-west-1 (hosts 3/30) at 2420001320. Auto-smoke will report in 2m.

mike: initial 2m check: synth pass improved from 97% -> 99.2% success on patched hosts. No latency regressed.

jen: perf counters show token refill steady, no cache thrashing. Cost delta negligible for short window.

alex: thumbs up to keep rolled-forward config and continue rollout if stable for 15m.

sara: agree — hold global rollout for 15m, monitor. If errors reappear, we plan immediate rollback to v2.13.9 + pin routing.

oncall-bot: Monitoring rule TEMP-LIMITER-CHANGE active; will notify in #incidents if 429 rate > 1% for 5m.

mike: adding a followup to release notes: "temporarily increased limiter burst in eu-west-1 to mitigate synthetic/ingest thrash; revert if sustained."

jen: I'll schedule automated revert after 30m unless flagged.

sara: closing ticket draft with the mitigation steps, will update INC-3421 with timeline.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused globally until 2420002300 or manual resume. Current status: held, patch active on 10% eu-west-1.

alex: thanks all — document action for postmortem if needed. :thumbsup:
